style: STYLE RULES: Hand-made pixel art in exactly the style of the reference image(s): crisp square pixels on a strict grid (each art pixel is one solid square block of image pixels), no anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft gradients between blocks, no noisy dithering. Warm natural palette, soft painterly shading with light from the upper left, thin dark-brown outlines, just like the reference. The reference images show the style and scale only: draw new subjects, do not copy or edit the reference. BACKGROUND: one flat solid magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere around the subjects, with no shadows, ground, grass, scenery, glow or texture on it. Leave clear magenta space between separate subjects. No text, letters, numbers, labels, borders or frames.

jobs.title: Eve, full body, front / back / side
jobs.prompt: Game character sprite of Eve, the first woman (Genesis 2), made to match Adam in the reference: same pixel scale (each art pixel is an 8x8 block), same height (about 116 art pixels tall, from the top of the head to the soles), same proportions, palette and shading. Long wavy dark-brown hair reaching her waist, warm olive skin, kind face. Modest clothing of large overlapping green leaves: a leaf top that covers her chest and shoulders and a leaf skirt down to the knees, like Adam's leaf skirt. Barefoot. Draw her three times in one row, full body, standing still with arms relaxed: 1) facing the viewer, 2) seen from behind, 3) facing right in side profile like the reference.
